name: Mobius Materials
old_description: See how Mobius sources certified parts in under two weeks — book a live walkthrough with our team.
about:
Mobius Materials is based in Richmond, Virginia. The company was founded by Margaret Upshur, who serves as CEO. Upshur started the business after experiencing the waste of excess electronic components and high procurement costs while leading operations at an IoT module manufacturer; she created Mobius to fix that breakdown and return unused parts to the supply chain.

The company operates as a distributor and reseller of electronic components, specializing in verified integrated circuits (ICs) from major manufacturers such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Vishay, Murata, Onsemi, Microchip, STMicroelectronics, and NXP Semiconductors. It sources certified parts, tests them for authenticity, and also purchases excess inventory from manufacturers. The platform provides a marketplace for buying and selling components, with services including bill-of-materials (BOM) optimization and contract manufacturing services. Millions of parts are listed in stock across the supported manufacturer lines.

Mobius serves electronics manufacturers, including IoT module makers and hardware manufacturers. Customers include CEOs and operations leaders at manufacturing companies who need to reduce component costs and manage excess inventory. For example, Hailey N., CEO of a manufacturer, reported saving 25% on BOM costs, and Kendell W., a Manufacturing & Operations Leader, increased excess inventory sales from fewer than two parts per month to over ten orders monthly.

The company differentiates itself by vetting suppliers and comprehensively testing part authenticity, offering 10–70% off common parts at market rates, and providing access to rare stock from other manufacturers' excess. Its stated mission is to improve manufacturers' P&L and get unused parts back into the supply chain.
